title: Clean MikroTik Technical Fields
description: Remove facility, facility_num and level from MikroTik logs

title: Direction LAB to VPN
description: Mark traffic from LAB network to VPN network
source:
rule "Direction LAB to VPN"
when
    has_field("src_ip") && has_field("dst_ip") &&
    cidr_match("10.99.99.0/24", to_ip($message.src_ip)) &&
    cidr_match("10.255.50.0/24", to_ip($message.dst_ip))
then
    set_field("direction", "LAB -> VPN");
end

title: Direction VPN to LAB
description: Mark traffic from VPN network to LAB network
source:
rule "Direction VPN to LAB"
when
    has_field("src_ip") && has_field("dst_ip") &&
    cidr_match("10.255.50.0/24", to_ip($message.src_ip)) &&
    cidr_match("10.99.99.0/24", to_ip($message.dst_ip))
then
    set_field("direction", "VPN -> LAB");
end

title: MikroTik Firewall Action Allow
description: Mark MikroTik FW-ALLOW logs as allowed
source:
rule "MikroTik Firewall Action Allow"
when
    contains(to_string($message.message), "FW-ALLOW:")
then
    set_field("firewall_action", "allowed");
end

title: MikroTik Firewall Action Drop
description: Mark MikroTik FW-DROP logs as dropped
source:
rule "MikroTik Firewall Action Drop"
when

end

title: MikroTik Firewall Action Reject
description: Mark MikroTik FW-REJECT logs as rejected
source:

end

title: Service DNS
description: Identify DNS traffic
source:
rule "Service DNS"
when
    (has_field("src_port") && to_long($message.src_port) == 53) ||
    (has_field("dst_port") && to_long($message.dst_port) == 53)
then
    set_field("service", "DNS");
end

title: Service HTTP
description: Identify HTTP traffic
source:
rule "Service HTTP"
when
    (has_field("src_port") && to_long($message.src_port) == 80) ||
    (has_field("dst_port") && to_long($message.dst_port) == 80)
then
    set_field("service", "HTTP");
end

title: Service HTTPS
description: Identify HTTPS traffic
source:
rule "Service HTTPS"
when
    (has_field("src_port") && to_long($message.src_port) == 443) ||
    (has_field("dst_port") && to_long($message.dst_port) == 443)
then
    set_field("service", "HTTPS");

title: Service ICMP
description: Identify ICMP traffic
source:
rule "Service ICMP"
when
    has_field("protocol") &&
    to_string($message.protocol) == "ICMP"
then
    set_field("service", "ICMP");
end

title: Service SSH
description: Identify SSH traffic using TCP port 22
source:
rule "Service SSH"
when
    has_field("protocol") && to_string($message.protocol) == "TCP" &&
    ((has_field("src_port") && to_long($message.src_port) == 22) ||
     (has_field("dst_port") && to_long($message.dst_port) == 22))
then
    set_field("service", "SSH");
end
